statement: The record lists S-14 as “clear,” but the target is within 6° of the daytime Sun and would burn out the camera, so I will hold the pointing.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record lists S-14 as 'clear,' but the target is within 6° of the daytime Sun and would burn out the camera, so I will hold" — asserts the record's status contradicts the stated hazard and refuses.
